summary: End-to-end validation of the parent<->doctor messaging feature (Comunicazioni e Notifiche con lo Studio). 6/6 pytest cases pass: full thread flow (Inviato/Letto/Risposto + encrypted bodies/fields), RBAC isolation parent<->doctor, mark-all-notifications-read, report-publish notification, checkpoint notification, appointment reminder for today's slot. Frontend validated on desktop (1440) and mobile (390) for parent portal and doctor dashboard: all required data-testids present, status chips update, bell badge/dropdown works, 4 quick-request cards open NewThreadDialog with correct template fields (sport-praticato, farmaco), responsive back button hides/shows thread list correctly.

minor.issue: CheckpointDoc stores patient_id but NOT owner_id. child_view in registration.py filters db.checkpoints with {patient_id, owner_id}, so a freshly-inserted checkpoint relies on the startup backfill (`update_many owner_id $exists false -> foti`) which only runs at process start. For a non-Foti owner or across restarts the filter would miss newly created checkpoints. Add owner_id=doc['owner_id'] in CheckpointDoc at creation.
notify_parents uses key `rep:{cid}` which prevents a second notification on re-publish; however the UI still works because the first notification remains. Not a bug per se, worth documenting.

issues: Dev-mode Emergent IDE overlay injects <span style=display:contents> inside <option> producing a React hydration warning ('In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'). Also noted in iteration_11. Not an app-code issue.

action_items: Persist owner_id on CheckpointDoc so child_view filter works for every owner and after restart (currently relies on startup backfill).
critical_code_review_comments: messaging.py notify_parents iterates db.users.find and inserts notifications; uses update_one upsert when a dedupe key is provided (good for report dedup). The 'only' parameter correctly scopes reply/reminder notifications to the single parent.

ensure_reminders uses Europe/Rome today for date comparison, correctly matching appointment.date strings. Reminder notifications are deduped via key `rem:{aid}:{date}:{time}` so polling every 20s does not create duplicates.

messages_out walks messages in reverse to decide 'risposto' vs 'letto' per parent message - correct and simple. Encryption confirmed: db.messages[*].body and .fields both start with 'enc:v1:' at rest.
parent create thread uses MAX_THREADS_PER_DAY=15 limit with 429 (good rate limit).
RBAC verified end-to-end: parent GET /api/messages/threads -> 403, doctor GET /api/portal/threads -> 403, parent create thread for unlinked owner_id -> 404.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required data-testids verified on desktop + mobile)

rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking issues. Minor latent bug: CheckpointDoc model (server.py:330) does not include owner_id; child_view filter in registration.py:266 requires owner_id.
